summary: Default-off, explicitly selected, read-only App Engine deployment.files adapter with native App/project/bucket ownership, generation pinning and required deployed SHA1 verification before offline detectors.

hooks: gcp_appengine_source_secret_indicators.jobs(collector, scope): schedule only after native project and bucket dependency envelopes complete
gcp_appengine_source_secret_review_20261019.install(): explicit and idempotent; not called from registry
root_remaining: Admit explicit selector and named-check planner kind in shared option/planner seams.
Schedule jobs after project and bucket dependencies, merge selection_metadata, and explicitly call install during admission.
Map the check to the existing secrets finding type and follow existing native admission/fixture/catalog conventions; no numbered compliance mapping is asserted.
Run centralized pytest and broader integration checks; no shared files were changed.
reused_readers: Cloud Build dedicated uncached bounded _json_get and native _project helper
Selected-object _bound_bucket, selected_targets, _metadata, _read, _text, deadline/cancellation and bounded dual-detector scan_content primitives
Selected-object pure consumer and Cloud Build envelope helper

contract_evidence.finding: deployment.files is the native GCS manifest included with the version; deployment is exposed by full-view reads.
FileInfo documents path-style GCS HTTP(S) sourceUrl and a hexadecimal file SHA1 in sha1Sum; missing sha1Sum is unsupported.
Read a specific version with the native GET endpoint and request FULL view.
FULL is the actual enum value supplying deployment details.
Application.id equals its Google Cloud project ID; validate native App name and id against CRM projectId.
Native bucket projectNumber independently binds the source bucket to CRM v3 projects/NUMBER.
Resolve object generation using metadata, then request metadata and media with generation and ifGenerationMatch.

identity_contract: One explicit project scope; 1-4 unique exact apps/PROJECT/services/SERVICE/versions/VERSION selectors from that project; reject wildcards, mutable aliases, queries and reserved version names.
Require complete native CRM v3 project identity and bucket collection with successful attached native read provenance; validate App.id/name and Version.id/name.
Accept standard-environment file manifests only, with 1-4 distinct supported source objects and mandatory native SHA1 per file; reject containers, zip and other deployment alternatives.

Parse only documented exact storage.googleapis.com path-style GCS URLs; discard the entire query and never execute the source URL. Bind bucket.projectNumber before any GCS source metadata or media read.

Resolve real generation, validate complete supported GCS text metadata, then read generation-pinned metadata/media from fixed Storage JSON API endpoints. Compare SHA1 before UTF-8/binary validation and offline detector execution.

Safe App/version manifest and GCS bucket/object hash-generation projections accompany their owned native read receipts; pure consumer rejects altered generation/hash values, source ownership, request counts and incomplete detector evidence.
PASS covers only the entire supported native deployment.files manifest observed and hash-matched; no runtime contents, generated artifacts, images, historical contents or all-code claim is made.

privacy.receipts: Fixed operation names, opaque resource IDs, scope, status, count and allowlisted identity projections only; no source URLs or queries.
privacy.diagnostics: Reject HTTP wire debug or urllib3 connectionpool DEBUG before source reads.

bounds.download_bound: Source limit plus at most 20 bounded metadata reads and one-byte limit sentinels stays below 2 MiB; shared-state prior activity can conservatively exhaust this adapter.
bounds.no_enumeration: No service/version/source-object listing, retries, redirects, arbitrary external reads or archive extraction.

unknown_cases: Partial metadata, media or dependency coverage

validation.execution: PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python, direct invocation of test functions with pytest.MonkeyPatch; pytest runner never invoked
validation.syntax_whitespace_checks: passed on all three Python files
validation.real_detectors: Pinned Kingfisher 1.4.0 and TruffleHog 3.92.5 exercised on clean and synthetic GitHub-token text; all network sockets blocked in source tests.

limitations: API fields are optional in practice: absent or unusable source/hash metadata returns UNKNOWN, never an invented positive.
SHA1 is the native file-equivalence metadata supplied by App Engine; this adapter adds no stronger deployment attestation.
Calls are bounded globally per shared reader state: a requested selection can exceed available call/time budget and remain UNKNOWN.
Shared integration, canonical taxonomy/catalog files and centralized pytest remain coordinator-owned.

root_integration.description: Native complete supported deployment.files manifest only; runtime contents and generated artifacts are outside scope.

acceptance.scope: Affected content authorization, transport, owner binding, shared fixtures and natural evidence regression cohort; no live GCP validation.
